# Voice guide

## Principles

### Plain over clever

> Every shipment, quoted in one place.

Say what the broker gets, in the fewest words.

### Name the broker's problem first

"A spreadsheet goes out of date the moment a carrier changes a rate."

Lead with what goes wrong for them, then with what fixes it.

## Words we use and avoid

We say quote, never bid.

## By channel

Nothing in the material covers this.

## What the material does not show

The material holds no emails or posts, so how the voice changes from one
channel to another is not known yet.
